body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> Samsung Electronics revealed ‘YPZ5F’, 11.4mm-thick slim design MP3P at KES 2006. It features a scratch protection LCD and solid metal material case. You can play up to 39 hours with chargible lithium polymer battery.
